{{Quote|As you approach the end of your jump, be advised that you are to meet the Alliance transport ''Celestial''. You are to take command of the ship and see it to its destination. Further coordinates will be provided in due course.|Commander Avalon|<ref name="O" />}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Avalon''' served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Avalon relayed orders to an Alliance team aboard the ''[[Long Shot]]'' to rendezvous with the [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']], which was carrying prisoners including [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers [[District Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zardra]], [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[EL-434]], and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Celis Mott]].
